tasks.title: Build the Afterthought single-file experience
tasks.outcome: A person can open afterthought.html and complete a bounded four-stage reflection flow with a faithful summary.

acceptance.criterion: afterthought.html opens without a build step and exposes Begin, four stages, skip/back controls, and a summary
acceptance.verify_by: Open the file in a browser and traverse the flow
acceptance.evidence: agent-browser opened the local file; snapshot showed Begin; browser eval clicked next through all four stages; final snapshot showed Your afterthought and ARRIVE/NAME/SORT/NEXT.

acceptance.criterion: Prompts are neutral and include an explicit non-medical boundary
acceptance.verify_by: Review rendered copy against first-use-flow design
acceptance.evidence: Rendered snapshots showed observation-oriented prompts; footer states Reflection tool, not medical care.; static check passed required surfaces.

boundaries: No clinical assessment, accounts, remote services, or external assets
evidence: Browser traversal reached final summary with all four stage headings.

tasks.title: Prove local persistence and privacy behavior
tasks.outcome: The draft survives refresh and can be intentionally erased while remaining offline.

acceptance.criterion: Draft text is restored after reload and Clear local note removes it
acceptance.evidence: Browser entered test persistence, reloaded, clicked Begin, and snapshot restored the text. Clear local note resets localStorage in source.

acceptance.criterion: Artifact contains no external network dependency
acceptance.verify_by: Static source scan for URLs, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, and imports
acceptance.evidence: node tests/verify.mjs returned static pass, bytes 6375, network_patterns 0, required_surfaces 7.

boundaries: No server deployment or cross-browser certification
evidence: Static scan passed with zero network patterns.
